sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，《纽约时报》.

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》.

sentences.en: Today, an extraordinary plan to rush a series of executions on Arkansas's death row.
sentences.zh: 今天，一项非同寻常的计划将在阿肯色州死囚牢房仓促执行一系列死刑.

sentences.en: The story of a controversial drug at the heart of the plan and a race against the clock.
sentences.zh: 这是一场与时间的赛跑，也是关于该计划核心处决药物充满争议的故事.

sentences.en: Eight men, ten days.
sentences.zh: 八个人，十天.

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月15日，星期三.

sentences.en: Near Grady, Arkansas, along the Arkansas River, sits the Varner Unit.
sentences.zh: 在阿肯色州格雷迪附近，沿着阿肯色河，坐落着瓦纳尔惩教所.

sentences.en: The high-security prison is where the state keeps its inmates who are waiting to die.
sentences.zh: 这座高度戒备的监狱关押着该州等待死刑的囚犯.

sentences.en: So you've got eight men in Arkansas who have been on death row, in some cases, for decades.
sentences.zh: 所以阿肯色州有八名死囚，其中一些人被关押了几十年.

sentences.en: Alan Blinder is a reporter for The Times based in the South.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·布林德是《纽约时报》常驻南部的记者.

sentences.en: These are men who were convicted of some of the most heinous crimes that a state can ever see.
sentences.zh: 这些人犯下的都是一个州所能见到的最滔天的罪行.

sentences.en: And now, after years of waiting, these eight men are scheduled to die.
sentences.zh: 现在，经过多年的等待，这八名男子预定将要被处决.

sentences.en: It is a pace of execution that researchers say is unprecedented in the modern history of the death penalty in the United States.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，这种处决的速度在美利坚合众国死刑的现代史上是前所未有的.

sentences.en: All eight, over ten days.
sentences.zh: 全部八人，在十天内.

sentences.en: Among them, there was a man named Don Davis, who actually this month marked the 25th anniversary of being sentenced to death.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个叫唐·戴维斯的人，本月正好是他被判处死刑的25周年纪念日.

sentences.en: My name is Devin.
sentences.zh: 我叫德文.

sentences.en: What's his state of mind right now?
sentences.zh: 他现在的心态怎么样？

sentences.en: It's very tense, and these people have been on death row for a long time.
sentences.zh: 气氛非常紧张，这些人已经在死囚牢房待了很长时间.

sentences.en: It all comes down to a drug called midazolam.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结于一种叫做咪达唑仑的药物.

sentences.en: How to give your child midazolam.
sentences.zh: 如何给儿童使用咪达唑仑.

sentences.en: So midazolam is one of the most popular drugs that you will find in any hospital setting.
sentences.zh: 咪达唑仑是你在任何医院环境中都能找到的最受欢迎的药物之一.

sentences.en: It is very popular sedative.
sentences.zh: 它是一种非常受欢迎的镇静剂.

sentences.en: It is sprayed into the nose using a syringe and atomizer.
sentences.zh: 它是用注射器和雾化器喷入鼻腔的.

sentences.en: But midazolam is also an execution drug.
sentences.zh: 但咪达唑仑也是一种行刑药物.

sentences.en: It is used in lethal injection cocktails.
sentences.zh: 它被用于注射死刑的药物组合中.

sentences.en: And the state of Arkansas's supply of midazolam is scheduled to expire at the end of April.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州库存的咪达唑仑预定在四月底过期.

sentences.en: What do you mean expire?
sentences.zh: 你说的过期是什么意思？

sentences.en: Every drug you will find out there has an expiration date.
sentences.zh: 你在外面能找到的每一种药都有保质期.

sentences.en: Effective nighttime cold and flu symptom relief in just one dose.
sentences.zh: 只需一剂，即可有效缓解夜间感冒和流感症状.

sentences.en: Whether it's the NyQuil that you keep in your medicine cabinet or, in this case, midazolam, it will reach the end of its shelf life, if you will.
sentences.zh: 无论是你药箱里常备的解药，还是本案中的咪达唑仑，用行话来说，它的保质期都要到了.

sentences.en: And it is illegal, essentially, to administer it in this kind of context once the drug is expired.
sentences.zh: 而且从本质上讲，一旦药物过期，在这样的环境下去使用它是违法的.

sentences.en: And Arkansas is not certain whether they'll be able to obtain any more midazolam.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州无法确定他们是否还能买到更多的咪达唑仑.

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: The trouble for Arkansas is pharmaceutical companies are broadly opposed to their drugs being used in lethal injections.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州面临的麻烦是，制药公司普遍反对将其药物用于死刑注射.

sentences.en: So they have moved to cut off the supply to states that want to use them for executions.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们采取行动，切断了对那些想要将这些药物用于行刑的州的供应.

sentences.en: In some cases, we've seen letters from pharmaceutical companies to states saying,
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，我们看到制药公司写信给各个州说，

sentences.en: Our drug is not supposed to be used for an execution.
sentences.zh: 我们的药不是用来行刑的.

sentences.en: If you're going to use it, please send it back to us and we'll give you a refund.
sentences.zh: 如果你要用它，请把它退还给我们，我们会给你退款.

sentences.en: Why are the companies so opposed?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些公司如此反对？

sentences.en: It is generally a combination of politics and morality, to be quite honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这通常是政治和道德的结合.

sentences.en: Some companies say they have a clear moral stand against the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 一些公司表示，他们对死刑有着明确的道德立场.

sentences.en: Even supporters of the death penalty, even supporters of midazolam, concede that this is nobody's first choice drug for executions.
sentences.zh: 即使是死刑的支持者、甚至咪达唑仑的支持者也承认，在行刑时，没有人会把这当作第一选择的药物.

sentences.en: What's its history?
sentences.zh: 它的历史是怎样的？

sentences.en: It is a very popular sedative.
sentences.zh: 它是一种非常受欢迎的镇静剂.

sentences.en: It was invented in the 1970s as an alternative to Valium.
sentences.zh: 它发明于20世纪70年代，作为安定药的替代品.

sentences.en: Originally synthesized RO21-3981.
sentences.zh: 最初合成代号为RO21-3981.

sentences.en: Yeah, that's this one.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这个.

sentences.en: That's midazolam.
sentences.zh: 这就是咪达唑仑.

sentences.en: So there was a team of chemists who were working in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个化学家团队在新泽西州工作.

sentences.en: And one of them was a man named Armin Falser.
sentences.zh: 其中一人名叫阿尔敏·法尔瑟.

sentences.en: I was the midazolam man.
sentences.zh: 我就是“咪达唑仑先生”.

sentences.en: And he is still alive and well these days.
sentences.zh: 他如今依然健在，身体硬朗.

sentences.en: He's living out in Tucson and enjoying retirement.
sentences.zh: 他住在图森，享受着退休生活.

sentences.en: Have you ever been sedated with it?
sentences.zh: 你曾经注射过这种镇静剂吗？

sentences.en: I got it when I had a colonoscopy.
sentences.zh: 我做肠镜检查时用过.

sentences.en: I told the doctor when he was giving me the drug that I invented the drug.
sentences.zh: 医生给我药的时候，我告诉他这药是我发明的.

sentences.en: He thought I was fantasizing.
sentences.zh: 他以为我在幻想.

sentences.en: It has been one of the most important drugs out there.
sentences.zh: 它是现今最重要的药物之一.

sentences.en: The World Health Organization lists it as one of the world's essential medicines.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织将其列为世界基本药物之一.

sentences.en: And for a long time it wasn't used in executions.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，它并没有被用于行刑.

sentences.en: Because the purpose of midazolam is less to actually kill the prisoner.
sentences.zh: 因为咪达唑仑的目的与其说真的是杀死囚犯，

sentences.en: And it's more to sedate them and make the other lethal injection drugs painless.
sentences.zh: 不如说是让他们平静下来，并让其他注射死刑药物时不会感到痛苦.

sentences.en: The argument that we hear from critics of midazolam is that it is unable to sufficiently sedate a prisoner.
sentences.zh: 我们从咪达唑仑批评者那里听到的论点是，它无法充分使囚犯镇静.

sentences.en: So when these other drugs are pumped through them, it causes pain and suffering.
sentences.zh: 因此，当这些其他药物被注入他们体内时，会引起痛苦和折磨.

sentences.en: The nation's third botched execution in six months has rekindled the debate over the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 全国六个月内的第三次拙劣行刑重新点燃了关于死刑的辩论.

sentences.en: Have there been problems with this drug when it's used for lethal injections?
sentences.zh: 当这种药物用于注射死刑时，曾出现过问题吗？

sentences.en: There have sometimes been probleMs.
sentences.zh: 有时确实出现过问题.

sentences.en: Arizona inmate Joseph Rudolph Wood.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州囚犯约瑟夫·鲁道夫·伍德.

sentences.en: Oklahoma inmate Clayton Lockett.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州囚犯克莱顿·洛克特.

sentences.en: And there have been very high profile probleMs.
sentences.zh: 而且还出现过非常轰动的问题.

sentences.en: In Arizona in 2014, there was an execution involving midazolam.
sentences.zh: 2014年，亚利桑那州发生了一起使用咪达唑仑的死刑执行.

sentences.en: And it lasted nearly two hours.
sentences.zh: 过程持续了近两个小时.

sentences.en: The execution took so long that his lawyers had time to file an emergency appeal while it was happening.
sentences.zh: 这次行刑持续了如此之久，以至于他的律师甚至有时间在行刑过程中提交紧急上诉.

sentences.en: That execution did not go very well.
sentences.zh: 那次行刑进行得不太顺利.

sentences.en: I sat down with Dale Bache.
sentences.zh: 我和戴尔·巴奇坐在一起谈了谈.

sentences.en: He's an assistant federal defender in Phoenix who witnessed the execution of Joe Wood.
sentences.zh: 他是菲尼克斯的一名联邦助理辩护律师，曾目击乔·伍德的死刑执行.

sentences.en: So the process all started at about 1.30.
sentences.zh: 整个过程大约在1点30分开始.

sentences.en: And by 1.40, they had the first line in.
sentences.zh: 到1点40分，他们已经插好了第一根导管.

sentences.en: By 1.50, he was saying, is the curtain open?
sentences.zh: 到了1点50分，他说，窗帘拉开了吗？

sentences.en: And we saw Joe Wood laying on the execution table.
sentences.zh: 我们看到乔·伍德躺在行刑台上.

sentences.en: He was strapped down.
sentences.zh: 他被绑在上面.

sentences.en: Joe made his last remarks.
sentences.zh: 乔发表了他的遗言.

sentences.en: And then the process began.
sentences.zh: 然后行刑程序开始了.

sentences.en: By, let's see, 1.57, he was unconscious.
sentences.zh: 等到，让我看看，1点57分，他失去了知觉.

sentences.en: What I saw was Joe Wood's eyes start to close.
sentences.zh: 我看到的是乔·伍德的眼睛开始闭上.

sentences.en: His breathing became shallow.
sentences.zh: 他的呼吸变得浅促.

sentences.en: And compared to other executions I witnessed, it all appeared to be going according to plan.
sentences.zh: 与我目击的其他死刑相比，一切似乎都按计划进行.

sentences.en: At about 2.05.
sentences.zh: 大约在大约2点05分.

sentences.en: But all of a sudden, his mouth opened wide.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，他的嘴张得很大.

sentences.en: His head lurched back.
sentences.zh: 他的头部猛地向后仰.

sentences.en: And it looked like Joe was struggling to breathe.
sentences.zh: 看起来乔呼吸得很困难.

sentences.en: You know, and it just sort of looked like a fish opening and closing his mouth.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那看起来就像一条鱼在张合着嘴巴.

sentences.en: His mouth closed.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴闭上了.

sentences.en: And then a few seconds later, it opened again.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，又张开了.

sentences.en: It looked like he was trying to catch his breath.
sentences.zh: 看起来他一直在努力喘气.

sentences.en: Inmate Joseph Wood was pronounced dead today at 3.49 Arizona time at the Arizona State Prison Complex in Florence.
sentences.zh: 囚犯约瑟夫·伍德于今天亚利桑那时间3点49分在弗洛伦斯的亚利桑那州立监狱综合大楼被宣布死亡.

sentences.en: It took Mr. Wood 1 hour and 57 minutes to die.
sentences.zh: 伍德先生花了1小时57分钟才死去.

sentences.en: How long is it supposed to take for someone to die from lethal injection?
sentences.zh: 注射死刑通常需要多长时间才能让人死亡？

sentences.en: Just a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 只需几分钟.

sentences.en: We've heard of executions often being, you know, 5, 15, 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们听说死刑通常，你知道的，持续5、15、20分钟.

sentences.en: And that's the whole procedure.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个过程.

sentences.en: Arizona Governor Jan Brewer has ordered a full review of the state's execution procedures.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州州长简·布鲁尔已下令对该州的行刑程序进行全面审查.

sentences.en: It's not, we're not talking about an extended period of time, but two hours is just extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这不是，我们不是在讨论很长一段时间，但两个小时简直太不寻常了.

sentences.en: And also the drugs used in the execution are under investigation.
sentences.zh: 而且行刑中使用的药物也在调查之中.

sentences.en: Witnesses say Wood gasped for air, which could be a side effect of both of those drugs.
sentences.zh: 目击者称，伍德大口喘气，这可能是这两种药物的副作用.

sentences.en: Arizona found that their protocols had worked.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州发现他们的规程是奏效的.

sentences.en: They believed that everyone had done their job.
sentences.zh: 他们相信每个人都尽到了职责.

sentences.en: And they also argued that the prisoner in that case had been sedated and felt no pain.
sentences.zh: 他们还辩称，该案中的囚犯已经接受了镇静，并没有感到疼痛.

sentences.en: And is there any evidence to suggest otherwise?
sentences.zh: 有什么证据表明并非如此吗？

sentences.en: Well, the problem is, obviously, you can't talk to this prisoner afterward to ask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题显而易见，事后你无法与这位囚犯对话来询问.

sentences.en: But there were certainly suggestions and witnesses reported that Mr. Wood gasped something on the order of more than 600 times over the course of the execution,
sentences.zh: 但确实有迹象表明，目击者报告说，伍德先生在行刑过程中大口喘气的次数大约超过600次，

sentences.en: which is a remarkable number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个惊人的数字.

sentences.en: So given what you've just told me about that Arizona case,
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于你刚才对我讲的亚利桑那州的那个案子，

sentences.en: is there any worry about using this drug to now execute eight people in quick succession in Arkansas in this really fast manner, that something could go wrong?
sentences.zh: 人们是否会担心现在用这种药物在阿肯色州以这种极快的速度连续处决八个人，会不会出什么差错？

sentences.en: Among some people, there certainly are worries about that.
sentences.zh: 在某些人当中，对此当然是有担忧的.

sentences.en: Critics of the death penalty argue that the risk of midazolam is too high, that you run the risk of an unconstitutionally painful execution.
sentences.zh: 死刑反对者认为，咪达唑仑的风险太高，你冒着违宪痛苦行刑的风险.

sentences.en: The Constitution forbids cruel and unusual punishment, but the courts have consistently upheld that the death penalty does not amount to that in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 宪法禁止残酷和不寻常的惩罚，但法院一直坚持认为死刑本身并不构成这种惩罚.

sentences.en: There was an interesting comment in the 2015 opinion from the court that dealt with midazolam, and it was Samuel Alito writing the opinion.
sentences.zh: 2015年法院关于咪达唑仑的裁决中有一条有趣的评论，该意见由塞缪尔·阿利托撰写.

sentences.en: And he talked about how the Constitution does not require the avoidance of all risk of pain.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了宪法并不要求完全避免所有的痛苦风险.

sentences.en: And then he added,
sentences.zh: 接着他补充道，

sentences.en: After all, while most humans wish to die a painless death, many do not have that good fortune.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，虽然大多数人希望死得毫无痛苦，但许多人并没有这样的好运气.

sentences.en: Holding that the Eighth Amendment demands the elimination of essentially all risk of pain would effectively outlaw the death penalty altogether.
sentences.zh: 如果认为第八修正案要求消除基本上所有的痛苦风险，那就等于彻底取缔了死刑.

sentences.en: The fact that this is still being litigated in the courts, I mean, the Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals, which sits in Cincinnati, was hearing arguments about midazolam this month.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这仍在法庭上进行诉讼，我是说，位于辛辛那提的第六巡回上诉法院本月一直在听取关于咪达唑仑的辩论.

sentences.en: So nothing is really settled in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，一切都还没有尘埃落定.

sentences.en: And everyone I talk to expects that there's a pretty good chance it will go back before the Supreme Court at some point down the road.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都认为，未来某天它很有可能会再次提交给最高法院.

sentences.en: Who knows when, though?
sentences.zh: 不过谁知道是什么时候呢？

sentences.en: You know this, of course.
sentences.zh: 你当然知道这一点.

sentences.en: There's still some question about whether midazolam, which is going to be used to execute Don Davis, could actually prolong the death of somebody like him.
sentences.zh: 仍然存在这样一个问题：用于处决唐·戴维斯的咪达唑仑，是否实际上会延长像他这样的人的死亡过程.

sentences.en: I wonder if he has expressed some wariness about that to you.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他是否向你表达过对此的一些忧虑.

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有.

sentences.en: About...
sentences.zh: 关于……

sentences.en: Deborah Salings, Don Davis' lawyer, has been practicing law in Arkansas for decades.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·萨林斯，唐·戴维斯的律师，在阿肯色州从事法律工作数十年.

sentences.en: Are you apprehensive?
sentences.zh: 你感到担忧吗？

sentences.en: That it could happen to your client?
sentences.zh: 担心这会发生在你的当事人身上？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很担忧.

sentences.en: What exactly is your worry?
sentences.zh: 你到底在担心什么？

sentences.en: Just from...
sentences.zh: 仅仅从……

sentences.en: It seems like it's an excruciation if you're not unconscious.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有失去知觉，这似乎是一种折磨.

sentences.en: And so that's...
sentences.zh: 所以这就是……

sentences.en: So what you're saying is if midazolam doesn't do its job just right, there's excruciating pain from an additional drug.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，如果咪达唑仑没有发挥它应有的作用，额外的药物会带来极大的痛苦.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的.

sentences.en: So as a defense attorney, what do you make of the state of Arkansas planning to execute eight men in 10 days?
sentences.zh: 那么作为一名辩护律师，你如何看待阿肯色州计划在10天内处决8名男子？

sentences.en: It's surely unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是前所未有的.

sentences.en: What do you make of it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: There's no good reason.
sentences.zh: 这没有任何充分的理由.

sentences.en: It bothers me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到困扰.

sentences.en: Deborah, do you plan on attending Don Davis' execution?
sentences.zh: 黛博拉，你打算出席唐·戴维斯的死刑行刑吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的.

sentences.en: So you'll watch...
sentences.zh: 所以你会看着……

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的.

sentences.en: ...and see how this all works or doesn't work or how it unfolds.
sentences.zh: ……看看这一切是如何运作的，或者又是如何停摆的，亦或是事情将如何发展。

sentences.en: Also watching will be Susan Taylor Conney.
sentences.zh: 同时参与旁听的还有苏珊·泰勒·科尼。

sentences.en: Hey, Susan, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嗨，苏珊，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I just wanted to start by asking you to tell me about your mother.
sentences.zh: 我想先请你跟我聊聊你的母亲。

sentences.en: Well, she was an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她是一位艺术家。

sentences.en: She painted.
sentences.zh: 她画画。

sentences.en: She graduated from Wichita State.
sentences.zh: 她毕业于威奇托州立大学。

sentences.en: She was a loving mother of four children.
sentences.zh: 她是四个孩子慈爱的母亲。

sentences.en: She was just a very giving, loving, educated, you know, woman that, you know, cared about everyone.
sentences.zh: 她只是一个非常无私、充满爱心、受过教育的人，你知道的，一个关心每个人的女性。

sentences.en: And she went through just a horrible, horrible time when he broke it.
sentences.zh: 而当他毁了这一切时，她经历了一段无比可怕的痛苦时光。

sentences.en: He came in.
sentences.zh: 他闯了进来。

sentences.en: She was fixing lunch.
sentences.zh: 她正在做午饭。

sentences.en: He came into the house and made her go around the house collecting valuables, like collect her jewelry, you know, silverware, whatever.
sentences.zh: 他闯进屋里，逼着她在屋里四处搜寻贵重物品，比如收集她的珠宝、银器之类的东西。

sentences.en: You know, he just took her around and then he ended up taking her downstairs and shot her execution style in the head.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他带着她四处搜寻，最后把她带到楼下，像处决犯人一样朝她的头部开枪。

sentences.en: That's terrible.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then he left and my dad came home later that evening from the business trip and, you know, was calling her name and couldn't find her.
sentences.zh: 然后他离开了，那天傍晚晚些时候我爸爸出差回来，你知道的，喊着她的名字却找不到她。

sentences.en: And he ended up finding her downstairs in that back room.
sentences.zh: 最后他在楼下的那个后房间里找到了她。

sentences.en: And then, you know, we got notified.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我们接到了通知。

sentences.en: No, that's what I know.
sentences.zh: 不，这就是我所知道的。

sentences.en: I notice you're not using his name.
sentences.zh: 我注意到你没有直呼他的名字。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's because you don't like to use his name.
sentences.zh: 我在想，是不是因为你不想用他的名字。

sentences.en: No, I don't like to say his name.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不想说他的名字。

sentences.en: And that's one of the reasons I want him executed, because I don't want him to say my mom's name.
sentences.zh: 这也是我想判他死刑的原因之一，因为我不想让他有机会说出我妈妈的名字。

sentences.en: What do you mean, say your mom's name?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思，说你妈妈的名字？

sentences.en: I don't want him to have anything.
sentences.zh: 我不想让他拥有任何东西。

sentences.en: My mom was too beautiful of a person for such a horrible person to say my mom's name.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是那么美好的人，像这种可怕的人根本不配提起我妈妈的名字。

sentences.en: He's juSt.
sentences.zh: 他简直……

sentences.en: And that's why I want him to put to death.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我想置他于死地。

sentences.en: I want to ask you a question that may be an uncomfortable one, given everything you've talked to me about and how important this execution is to you.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一个可能让人不太舒服的问题，考虑到你跟我谈过的一切，以及这场死刑对你有多么重要。

sentences.en: There is a debate over the use of a particular drug in lethal injections in the state of Arkansas called midazolam.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州在执行死刑时使用了一种名为咪达唑仑的特定药物，这引发了一场争论。

sentences.en: And I bet you've heard about it.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你一定听说过。

sentences.en: And whether it's the right drug, whether it's effective or whether in some cases it may actually prolong the death of somebody on death row.
sentences.zh: 关于这是否是正确的药物，它是否有效，或者在某些情况下，它是否实际上延长了死囚死刑犯的死亡过程。

sentences.en: Is that something you've given any thought to?
sentences.zh: 你有考虑过这方面的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I've thought about it.
sentences.zh: 对，我考虑过。

sentences.en: And I really don't care, to tell you honestly.
sentences.zh: 但老实跟你说，我真的不在乎。

sentences.en: Because, you know, he didn't think about what he did to my mom.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，他当时可没想过他对我的妈妈做了什么。

sentences.en: You know, people seem to forget that there's someone else in this story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们似乎忘了在这个故事里还有另一个人。

sentences.en: And it's a person that she had a huge family.
sentences.zh: 那就是她拥有一个庞大家庭的人。

sentences.en: We all miss her terribly.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都无比想念她。

sentences.en: My son has grown up with never having a grandmother, you know, Christmases.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子从小就没有祖母陪伴，没有办法一起过圣诞节。

sentences.en: So I don't care that he has to suffer for a little bit, 30 minutes or whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以我不介意他必须痛苦一会儿，30分钟或是多久都行。

sentences.en: Don Davis is scheduled to die on April 17th, the first of 10 days in which the eight men on Arkansas's death row will be executed,
sentences.zh: 唐·戴维斯定于4月17日被执行死刑，这是阿肯色州死囚牢房中的八名男子将在十天内接受死刑的第一例，

sentences.en: all by a lethal injection cocktail that includes midazolam.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都将通过包含咪达唑仑的注射药物组合来执行。

sentences.en: It's the first time that the state of Arkansas will have an execution in more than 11 years.
sentences.zh: 这将是阿肯色州11年多来首次执行死刑。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: One of the bright spots in the Congressional Budget Office's report on the new Republican health care plan, it would lower insurance prices.
sentences.zh: 国会预算办公室关于新的共和党医疗计划的报告中有一个亮点，那就是它将降低保险价格。

sentences.en: But the Times is reporting that it would do so by making insurance unaffordable for many older Americans.
sentences.zh: 但《纽约时报》报道称，它是通过让许多老年美国人买不起保险来做到这一点的。

sentences.en: My colleague Jonathan Weissman explains.
sentences.zh: 我的同事乔纳森·威斯曼对此进行了阐述。

sentences.en: Under the current Affordable Care Act, older people and voters get fairly large subsidies.
sentences.zh: 在现行的《平价医疗法案》下，老年人和选民可以获得相当大额的补贴。

sentences.en: And some of these tax subsidies can be as large as, you know, $15,000, $16,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 其中一些税收补贴甚至可以高达每年15,000美元、16,000美元。

sentences.en: Under the new law, those people would get maybe at most $4,000.
sentences.zh: 而在新法律下，这些人最多可能只能拿到4,000美元。

sentences.en: And their out-of-pocket expense could be $16,000, $17,000.
sentences.zh: 而他们的自付费用可能会高达16,000美元、17,000美元。

sentences.en: And we're talking about for somebody who's earning like $28,000.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的可是那些年收入大约在28,000美元左右的人。

sentences.en: So more than half your income would have to come out of your pocket to the insurance company to get you covered.
sentences.zh: 所以为了获得保险覆盖，你得掏出超过一半的收入交给保险公司。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 那可是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: It's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 确实是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Finally, the European Union's highest court has ruled that private companies can ban female workers from wearing headscarves on the job.
sentences.zh: 最后，欧洲联盟最高法院裁定，私营公司可以禁止女员工在工作时佩戴头巾。

sentences.en: The ruling comes as populist candidates across Europe are expressing alarm over what they say is the failure of Muslim residents to integrate into their societies.
sentences.zh: 此前，欧洲各地的民粹主义候选人纷纷对他们所说的穆斯林居民未能融入当地社会表示担忧。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
